title: chore(news): drop automatic retries and stop gists when enrichment fails
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: News pipeline model, image, GitHub API, and Discord webhook calls now make one attempt; an empty model answer fails the run. Failed classification or model/API change lookup stops gist creation and its Discord post instead of publishing a partially enriched gist, and the `enrichment` status field was removed. The push retry for the frequently updated `news` branch, the wait for images before Buffer, and rerun-safe delivery records remain. Pipeline and repair documentation now note that an empty answer is cached per request and requires the post to be written by hand. A practice run for 2026-10-11 produced identical daily text before and after the change; tests cover single attempts and gist-stopping failures.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow against a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
